research_question: On BabyAI-GoToLocal-v0 with the frozen Phase 1 policy, can a stateless current-observation blocked-forward mask explain the completion improvement of ExternalObservationCountWrapper, or does episode-local observation-count memory provide additional benefit beyond masking?

mask_rule.name: blocked_forward_mask_option1_target_exempt
mask_rule.variant: Option 1: exclude forward (2) iff obs['image'][3, 5] is impassable and does NOT match mission (color, type)

arms.A: Frozen Phase 1 policy baseline (argmax over {0, 1, 2}, stateless)
arms.C: Frozen Phase 1 policy + unchanged ExternalObservationCountWrapper (episode-local memory, reset() per episode)

statistical_protocol.primary_outcome: binary_episode_success (terminated and total_reward > 0.0 and exception is None)

strata_priority: A0_B1_C1 (rescued by both B and C)

pass1_live_rollouts.metric: t_decision_e2e_ns (encode_observation + forward_mlp + arm selection; no nested timers) plus separate Arm C wrapper.reset() timing

pass2_off_policy_fixed_trace.label: off_policy_fixed_input_cost_measurement_NOT_valid_arm_c_rollout
separate_passes: pass2a_t_decision_e2e_ns (encode_observation + forward_mlp + arm selection; Arm C reset() per episode)
pass2b_t_exec_layer_ns (arm selection only on precomputed probs; Arm C reset() per episode)
